Dear applicant,

Thank you for your enquiry about the Master’s programme Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin.

Regarding the application deadline, The regular application period for Summer Semester 27 has closed. The next regular application period is for Winter Semester 27/28, from 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 [Doc 1].

Required documents
The application must include the following documents:
- A copy of your degree certificate
- A copy of your grade transcript (with translation into English or German if issued in another language, plus an explanation of the grading system if not stated on the transcript)
- Evidence of at least one year of professional experience after your first university degree (employer confirmation letters or, for self-employed applicants, contracts and/or tax statements)
- Proof of English language proficiency (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic, a university-level programme taught in English for at least one year, or a complete English-language degree; no proof is required if English is the official language of your country of origin)
- A copy of your passport or identity card
- Curriculum vitae
- Letter of reference (academic and/or work-related)
- Motivation letter or a link to a motivation video [Doc 2]

Language of instruction
The programme is taught in English [Doc 3].

Study format
The programme is classified as a full-time presence study (Präsenzstudium) [Doc 4].

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your enquiry regarding the English language requirements for the Master’s programme Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin.

For admission to the programme, proof of English language proficiency at CEFR level C1 is required. Accepted tests and minimum scores include:
- TOEFL (internet-based): 95 points or higher
- IELTS: 7.0 points or higher
- PTE Academic Test: 76 points or higher

Alternatively, comparable tests that confirm CEFR level C1 may also be accepted. If you have completed a university-level programme taught entirely in English for at least one year, or hold a degree entirely taught in English, this can also be recognised as proof of level C1. Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from providing additional proof [Doc 1].

Please note that the official application review process will determine whether your submitted documents meet the programme’s requirements.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your enquiry regarding the Master’s programme in International Business at HTW Berlin.

1. Applying before graduation
HTW Berlin allows applicants who are in the final semester of their Bachelor’s degree to apply, provided they have already registered to write their final thesis [Doc 1]. If you are admitted, you must submit your completed Bachelor’s degree certificate by 20 January for a winter-semester start or by 20 June for a summer-semester start; otherwise your enrolment will become invalid [Doc 1].

2. English-language requirements
The International Business programme requires proof of English at C1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. Accepted tests and minimum scores are:
- TOEFL internet-based: 95 points
- IELTS (academic): 7.0 overall
- PTE Academic: 76 points
Tests must be no more than two years old [Doc 1, Doc 2]. If your Bachelor’s degree was completed in an English-language programme in an OECD country, you are exempt from providing this proof [Doc 2].

3. Application fee
If you apply via uni-assist (because you obtained your first academic degree outside Germany and are not an EU/EEA national), the application is subject to a fee charged by uni-assist [Doc 3]. If you apply through the HTW Berlin portal (e.g., because you earned your degree in Germany or are an EU/EEA national), there is no HTW application fee [Doc 2].

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services
